title: Technology Specialist
description:
**Company Description**
Amigosia Pvt Ltd is a growing organization focused on delivering technology-driven solutions to support modern business needs. Amigosia emphasizes continuous learning and encourages employees to explore new tools and methodologies. The organization is committed to maintaining an inclusive and respectful workplace. Joining Amigosia offers opportunities to work with diverse technologies and contribute to scalable, practical solutions.

Job Description – Technical Specialist (Finance & Procurement)

**Experience:**
10+ Years

**Employment Type:**
Full-time

**Job Level:**
Senior / Specialist

**Industry:**
Software Development / Enterprise Applications

**Preferred Domain Experience:**
Finance, Procurement, Real Estate / Property Management

About the Role

We are looking for an experienced Technical Specialist with over 10 years of experience in the software industry and strong domain knowledge in Finance and Procurement. The ideal candidate should have a deep understanding of business processes, functional workflows, and technical implementations across financial management and procurement systems.

The candidate will be responsible for understanding business requirements, translating them into technical and functional specifications, guiding development teams, and ensuring the successful implementation of enterprise software solutions.

Experience in Real Estate, Property Management, Facility Management, or Construction Management software will be an added advantage.

Key Responsibilities

**1. Domain & Functional Expertise**

* Demonstrate strong functional knowledge of Finance, Accounting, Procurement, and Vendor Management processes.
* Understand financial workflows, including Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, General Ledger, Budgeting, Invoicing, Taxation, and Financial Reporting.
* Understand procurement workflows, including Purchase Requests, Purchase Orders, Vendor Management, Quotations, Approvals, Goods/Service Receipts, and Payments.
* Analyse business processes and identify opportunities for automation and process optimization.

**2. Technical & Solution Design**

* Translate business requirements into functional specifications, technical documentation, and system workflows.
* Work closely with software architects, developers, UI/UX designers, and QA teams.
* Define system architecture requirements, integrations, APIs, and data flows for finance and procurement modules.
* Review technical solutions to ensure they align with business requirements and industry standards.
* Provide technical guidance and domain expertise throughout the software development lifecycle.

**3. Project Implementation & Client Engagement**

* Interact with clients and stakeholders to understand business requirements and operational challenges.
* Participate in requirement gathering, business process mapping, solution design, and implementation.
* Support UAT, system validation, deployment, and post-implementation activities.
* Coordinate with development teams to ensure timely and quality delivery.

**4. Real Estate / Property Management Domain (Preferred)**

* Knowledge of real estate financial operations, property accounting, and project cost management.
* Understanding of lease management, rental billing, maintenance expenses, vendor contracts, and facility management.
* Familiarity with property management systems, construction procurement, project budgeting, and financial tracking.
* Experience developing or implementing ERP, CRM, or property management solutions will be an advantage.

Required Skills & Qualifications

* 10+ years of experience in the software industry.
* Strong domain expertise in Finance, Accounting, and Procurement.
* Experience working on ERP, Financial Management Systems, Procurement Platforms, or Enterprise Applications.
* Ability to understand complex business requirements and convert them into software solutions.
* Experience in functional requirement documentation, workflow design, and system integration.
* Good understanding of APIs, databases, software architecture, and enterprise application development.
* Strong analytical, communication, stakeholder management, and problem-solving skills.
* Experience working with cross-functional development teams.

Preferred Experience

* Experience in Real Estate, Property Management, Facility Management, or Construction Management software.
* Experience with ERP platforms such as SAP, Oracle, Microsoft Dynamics, or similar enterprise systems.
* Exposure to financial automation, procurement automation, and workflow management platforms.
* Experience in client-facing technical consulting or solution architecture roles.

Key Expectations

* The candidate should be capable of acting as a domain and technical bridge between business stakeholders and software development teams, ensuring that complex Finance and Procurement business requirements are translated into scalable, practical, and user-friendly software solutions.

title: Helpdesk Support Specialist
description:
We are seeking an analytical Helpdesk Support Specialist with 6 months to 1 year of experience to manage our support queue and bridge the gap between our clients and internal teams. In this role, you will monitor incoming tickets, clarify issue details directly with customers, and coordinate seamlessly with L1, L2, L3 support, Process Consultants, and Developers to drive ticket resolutions without getting bogged down in code level debugging.

**Key Responsibilities**

• Queue Monitoring & Management: Monitor and track incoming support tickets via Zoho Desk (or equivalent ticketing platforms), prioritizing and responding to requests across email and IVR channels.

• Customer Clarification: Engage directly with users to gather context, reproduce issues, and clarify ambiguities regarding the business challenge behind each ticket.

• Process-Level Triage: Analyze support queries against overall business workflows rather than code architecture, assessing whether issues stem from user error, configuration needs, or system gaps.

• Cross-Functional Coordination: Act as the primary operational link between customers, internal Process Consultants, and Developers to ensure smooth ticket routing and escalation through L1, L2, and L3 tiers.

• Translation & Liaison: Translate non-technical customer pain points into clear, actionable functional requirements for developers and consultants.

• Lifecycle Tracking: Own the end-to-end journey of support tickets from initial intake and triage to testing, user verification, and final closure.

**Key Qualifications & Skills**

• Experience: 6 months to 1 year of experience in a helpdesk support, technical service

desk, or customer-facing operational role. (Zoho Desk experience is a plus, but not

mandatory).

• Business Acumen: Solid grasp of standard business processes and operational

workflows, focusing on how applications serve end-user needs.

• Communication Skills: Exceptional verbal and written communication skills to

articulate client requirements clearly across technical and non-technical teams.

• Problem-Solving & Inquiry: Strong analytical mindset to ask the right clarifying

questions, test functional workarounds, and investigate root operational causes.

• Time Management: Highly organized with the ability to manage multiple concurrent

support tickets calmly and efficiently in a fast-paced environment.

**Work Schedule & What We Offer**

• Work Schedule: 6 working days per week (Monday through Friday on-site/hybrid as

per location policy; Saturday dedicated as Work-From-Home).

• Competitive compensation with structured performance-based career growth.

• Comprehensive onboarding, mentorship, and exposure to enterprise business

automation tools.

• A supportive, collaborative culture that values continuous learning.

title: Oracle HCM Functional Consultant
description:

The ideal candidate will have a deep understanding of Oracle Cloud Payroll modules, strong analytical skills, and a proven ability to deliver successful implementations and support in a consulting environment.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Implementation and Support: Lead and manage Oracle Cloud Payroll implementation projects, including requirements gathering, solution design, configuration, testing, and deployment.
* Costing Expertise: Provide expert guidance on payroll costing, including setup, configuration, and troubleshooting of costing rules and processes.
* Client Collaboration: Work closely with clients to understand their payroll processes and requirements, offering recommendations for improvements and optimizations.
* Documentation: Develop and maintain project documentation, including functional specifications, test plans, and user guides.
* Training and Support: Conduct training sessions for clients and provide ongoing support to ensure successful adoption of Oracle Cloud Payroll solutions.
* Issue Resolution: Troubleshoot and resolve issues related to Oracle Cloud Payroll, providing timely and effective support to clients.
* Best Practices: Stay updated with the latest Oracle Cloud Payroll features, functionalities, and industry best practices to provide innovative solutions to clients.

**Qualifications**

* Experience: Minimum of 3 years of experience in Oracle Cloud Payroll implementation and support, with a focus on payroll costing.
* Technical Skills: Proficiency in Oracle Cloud Payroll modules, including Core HR, Benefits, and Compensation. Strong understanding of payroll costing rules and processes.
* Analytical Skills: Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills, with the ability to interpret complex payroll requirements and deliver effective solutions.
* 4+ years of experience in Cloud Payroll
* 3+ years of experience in Payroll Costing and US Taxation
* Accounting background is an added advantage

**Minimum One End-to-end Implementation Experience Required**

title: Technical Support Representative
description:
**Company Description**
Mexaware Solutions is a specialist IT solutions company based in Thrissur, Kerala, India, operating at the intersection of innovation and practicality. The team focuses on RFID and Bluetooth (BLE) tracking systems, barcode solutions, web development, mobile applications, and cloud infrastructure with DevOps. Mexaware delivers end-to-end technology solutions for asset management, people monitoring, inventory, point-of-sale, and broader digital transformation. Using a modern tech stack including Node.js, React.js, PostgreSQL, MySQL, MSSQL, Android, AWS, Kafka, MQTT, and Fastify, the company emphasizes simplicity, scalability, and timely delivery. Trusted by industry leaders such as Centena Group and ScreenCheck, Mexaware maintains a client-first mindset and a commitment to excellence.
  
**Role Description**
The Technical Support Representative is a full-time, on-site role based in Thrissur, Kerala. This role involves providing timely and accurate technical assistance to customers, including diagnosing issues, troubleshooting hardware and software problems, and guiding users through solutions. The representative will manage support tickets, document incidents, escalate complex issues to engineering teams, and follow up to ensure resolution and customer satisfaction. Daily tasks include responding to queries via phone, email, or chat, maintaining knowledge base articles, and collaborating with internal teams to improve products and services. The role also requires monitoring recurring issues, suggesting process improvements, and contributing to a high-quality support experience.
  
**Qualifications**

* Strong Customer Support and Customer Satisfaction skills, with the ability to communicate clearly and professionally.
* Hands-on Technical Support and Troubleshooting skills for software, hardware, and network-related issues.
* Solid Analytical Skills to diagnose problems, identify root causes, and propose effective solutions.
* Comfort working with IT concepts and tools; familiarity with web, mobile, or RFID/BLE systems is an advantage.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English; additional local language skills are a plus.
* Ability to work on-site in Thrissur, manage multiple cases simultaneously, and maintain accurate documentation.
* Prior experience in technical or customer support roles is preferred; exposure to SaaS or IT services is beneficial.
* Relevant diploma or degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field is desirable.

title: Service Now Senior Technical Consultant

Milestone is focused on building an employee\-first, performance\-based culture and for over 25 years, we have a demonstrated history of supporting category\-defining enterprise clients that are growing ahead of the market. The company specializes in providing solutions across Application Services and Consulting, Digital Product Engineering, Digital Workplace Services, Private Cloud Services, AI/Automation, and ServiceNow.  Our seasoned professionals deliver services based on Milestone’s best practices and service delivery framework. By leveraging our vast knowledge base to execute initiatives, we deliver both short\-term and long\-term value to our clients and apply continuous service improvement to deliver transformational benefits to IT.
